title: Development of Sustainable Manufacturing Protocol of 'Golden Tips Tea'
author: Md. Ismail Hossain
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Set environmental conditions
steps.instruction: Maintain the processing room at 86 °F (30 °C) and 94 % relative humidity for the entire experiment.

steps.title: Prepare oxidation time treatments
steps.instruction: Create five oxidation time treatments—T1 = 60 min, T2 = 70 min, T3 = 80 min, T4 = 90 min, T5 = 100 min—each with four replications to standardize the manufacturing protocol.

steps.title: Apply T4 manufacturing protocol
steps.instruction: For the T4 treatment, wither the tea leaves to 65 % (of the specified parameter), perform ideal rolling, oxidize for 90 minutes, then dry at 180–200 °F for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare clonal bud combinations
steps.instruction: Mix tea buds from the three clonal varieties BT2, BT4, and BT23 into nine combinations: C1 = 100 % BT2; C2 = 50 % BT2 + 50 % BT4; C3 = 80 % BT2 + 20 % BT4; C4 = 100 % BT4; C5 = 50 % BT4 + 50 % BT23; C6 = 80 % BT4 + 20 % BT23; C7 = 100 % BT23; C8 = 50 % BT2 + 50 % BT23; C9 = 80 % BT2 + 20 % BT23.

steps.title: Process clonal combinations
steps.instruction: Apply the T4 manufacturing protocol (65 % withering, ideal rolling, 90 min oxidation, drying at 180–200 °F for 30 min) to each clonal combination; the C3 combination (80 % BT2 + 20 % BT4) gave the best result, while C1, C9 also produced good quality and C7 is suitable for bulk production.
